support_tickets.subject: API timeout on batch data synchronization webhook
support_tickets.impact: Data sync delayed by 30-45 mins during peak hours on staging sandbox
support_tickets.root_cause_analysis: Payload serialization overhead during heavy table dump. Patch v2.4.1 hotfix scheduled for deployment this week.
support_tickets.resolution_plan: Patch ready for rollout; customer needs confirmation that timeout ceiling has been raised to 120s.

support_tickets.subject: Dashboard SSO token renewal fails intermittently
support_tickets.impact: Security team forced to re-login every 24h instead of 7-day session token
support_tickets.root_cause_analysis: SAML token lifetime mismatch with customer IdP cookie policy.
support_tickets.resolution_plan: Configuration adjustment guide provided; pending client IdP team confirmation.

support_tickets.subject: Billing invoice discrepancy for Q2 sandbox compute
support_tickets.root_cause_analysis: Metered billing calculation bug during multi-region test.
support_tickets.resolution_plan: Credit memo applied and ticket closed.
